review_description: Quoting was prompt and detailed.Installation was seamless and site was left relatively clean. Customer service was fantastic. Highly recommend getting solar installed from Glen and his team.

Its been a long and drawn out process. Some of it relating to a difficult neighbour but even allowing for that I have had to get them back to fix safety switch and monitoring wasnt working (and still isnt) as I remain unable to get my log in information. Every time I send an email or text it requires a follow up to get a response. Its been too protracted a process so far
Sales/quoting - prompt.Installation - Very polite, tidy and punctual.I'm still waiting for an inspector.
Customer service from internal admin needs improving (eg no acknowledgement or receipt for deposit paid)

We planned to put on solar panels and apply for a Victorian government rebate, so we sought three quotes. One was ridiculously cheap and the proposed equipment was low quality (and the company didn't have a good review here). The second was a bit cheaper than Glen Clark, but the panels and inverter were not well rated (on this site). Steve (a nice guy to deal with) from Glen Clark came out to inspect including going on to the roof, and we received a quote for 18 LG Neon 2 345W panels and Fronius Primo 5.0.1 SC inverter. The warranty on the LG panels was a major factor in our decision. We had no issues dealing with Glen Clark and all our questions were answered quickly. After the rebate was approved, we were advised (by Glen Clark) that the Fronius inverters were not available so they offered two alternatives. We went with the ABB UNO as it had better reviews on this site (and it also saved us some money). We had plenty of notice for the installation date and the four Glen Clark employees completed the job efficiently and cleanly. They also helped to move and put sealant on a couple of tiles that already had cracks in them. They were even kind enough to take multiple photos as the panels were being installed. In a nutshell, great company to deal with, good communication at all times, we had no problems at all.
After installation we found that shortcuts had been taken during installation of the roof rails which required 2 call backs to rectify

Communication was good from quoting to installation. Of the three installers contacted, these guys offered the best overall system. Their price point came in at a similar price to a competitor for a 5kw system, but they provided much better panels.The system was only just installed, but they are organising for the inspection to be completed, amd once that's done they will contact the local electricity distributor to connect me onto the grid.On the second day in with some clear weather at the tail end of winter, the system managed to generate 29kwh in a day.

Choosing to install solar is not just a financial decision its about quality, service and judgement about reliability. Glen Clark has provided excellent service and responsiveness with no heavy sales tactics.

I had my solar system installed by Glen Clark on Feb this year. Expertise and installation is very professional.  The value (top quality system) vs cost is good and it was the better of three quotes I got.Sales/quoting process was smooth, no issues. Glen even sent me another layout after chatting and I provided some feedback/requests from the first one. The quotation/report he sends is very good and comprehensive.Installation: First date had to be cancelled due to a local power outage. Second was cancelled by them due to installaters sick. Room for improvement there was that I was not notified and I had to call 90min to find out. Third installation attempt it all went well, they got on time, very polite and professional and explained me what they were doing and how to use the inverter at the end.Customer service was good but could be better. I mean, they responded many of my enquiries but some emails I sent got no response so I had to insist or call in some cases. So room for improvement there. They helped with the grid connection. They helped me with the paperwork for the Solar Vic grant, but this was not smooth and I had to send multiple emails. Apparently the broker who does their STCs credits delayed the process, but I was kind of in the dark for some time, not being properly informed. I finally got all the paperwork and got the rebate :)
So far so good.

Average service. The installer Dave turned up late on the day. He forgot to bring along the job sheet and asked me if I could show him the layout of the panels. Once the installation commenced, Dave realised he had run out of parts and so he went to buy parts while the apprentices sat around waiting for him. He turned up 2 hours later. By this stage, I had contacted their office for an explanation and they sent out Dylan to assist with the job. The apprentices werenâ€™t getting along with Dave and there was constant bickering. Dave was smoking in the garage and entered the house multiple times to use the toilet with dirty work shoes. On a couple of occasions he entered the house to use the toilet without seeking permission. The installation was completed at around 5 pm. They took a couple of minutes to take me over the inverter and quickly left. It took another two weeks to book a safety inspection. The inspector found a couple of faults with the installation and did not approve the system. It took another two weeks for the faults to be rectified. While signing up with Glen Clark, I knew I was paying premium price  but I was happy to do so thinking I would get top quality service. Unfortunately, that wasnâ€™t the case. I know of other households who went with other installers, paid less and had their systems up and running without any issues even though their process began after mine. No apologies from the company whatsoever. However, they were very quick to send me the final invoice the following day.Please shop around so you get better value for your investment. I do not recommend this company.

Glen gives good old fashioned, fair, honest service. Everything from information, choice to install was a breeze because we didnt have to worry about whether we were going to be taken for a ride. What a breath of fresh air! We found Glen on Whirlpool and we are very happy we did. Thank you!

Recently had my solar system installed by Glen's team and the process from requesting the quote through to install was a breeze.I had done a bit of research and was looking for a mid range quality system not one of those TV or newspaper deals that flash a lot of big numbers for a bargain basement price as I knew they wouldn't go the distance.I wanted the same with my installer and if you look at Whirlpool and Solar Quotes as 2 examples, you will find recommendation after recommendation for Glen Clark. I had also requested a quote from Glen back in 2013 so seeing the company still being highly recommended 6 years later meant a lot.Before install and with no obligation Glen personally came out for a site inspection and to answer any of our questions, no other installer I requested a quote from offered this service.The team that installed the system did a great job, Dylan called to check first before moving the inverter from the agreed location and I really appreciated his advice.If you're after a quality system, competitive price and professional service there is no need to look elsewhere.
You won't go wrong with this man
We had our system installed around 18 months ago and the whole process was very easy, yet thorough and informed. Glen's installers did an excellent job and it hasn't missed a beat. Highly recommend.
Glen took the time to explain exactly how the system would be installed and didnt overestimate the percentage of usage that the system would cover which enabled a more accurate payback calculation.
Glen is a very upfront and honest guy. everything was fast and professional.

I went to several suppliers to get quotes and some returned with quotes (4 did but 1 didn't). I chose Glen Clark because of reviews in Whirlpool forums and from your website. He was rather hard to get hold of. He supplied me the most comprehensive quote with indication of where the solar panels will be located and he did his best to align the panels to the North direction given the limited roof space. Also in the quote, he provided me the calculation of the payback period and how much annual solar generation from the system. He also came to do a site visit to confirm the order and answer all my queries. My system consists of LG NeON 2 335W and Enphase IQ7+ microinverters.
Glen was very helpful a provided 4 quotes in the end. Giving me options to choose which suited me best. Compared to other quotes for same high end equipment. He was by far the cheapest

I very much appreciated all of the information provided by the Solar Quotes website. It felt like a one stop shop for all the information I needed and it seemed trustworthy. I world recommend Solar Quotes to anyone else starting out looking at getting solar panels but not knowing much about it. Although I went with a supplier other than one suggested by Solar Quotes, I feel that Solar Quotes did very much help me to implement my plan to get solar panels, and within a relatively short time frame too.

I had panels and battery storage with backup installed. Glen and installers were very helpful throughout the process from design to installation and through to ironing out minor configuration issues after installation. Very quick to supply quote and arranged install within a couple of weeks.

Well done Finn, you have a very valuable service.  Iâ€™ll be reading your blog as battery prices come down.  That will be the next thing.  As a retired woman I could never have gone through this process by myself and made the right decisions, without the information on your site.  Keep up the good work.  All the best.

I went with Glen Clark after reading up some other reviews on your website and the forumsRe the installers recommended by your site -* One was over priced for the same system Glen Clark provided* Another did not have the system i was after* & the other - did not contact them as they took to long to initiate first contact

I did a lot of research on installers before choosing Glen Clark - key factors included their ratings online as well as them supplying a range of quality hardware (including both string and micro inverter systems).  Glen was very knowledgeable and provided useful advice when prompted without being pushy.  He visited the site and quote provided was detailed but clear - with 2nd alternative provided later on request.  I ended up going with Enphase S270 microinverters and LG Neon 320W panels.  The installers were efficient and friendly, and the system has performed faultlessly so far (~4 mths in).   The application process involving elec retailer was handled efficiently.  The Enphase user interface I have found really useful  to analyse both usage, production and net energy export.   I have no hesitation in recommending the installers.  I'm also grateful to Solarquotes as a great resource for learning all about solar!
Glen Clark provided me with the most detailed, most informative quote.

I found your solar checklist very useful. I went with a supplier not through solarquotes. I contacted them based on the positive reviews on Whirlpool forum. He proactively offered to come down and check to provide a quote (which I wasn't really expecting but I appreciated). The price quoted by Glen Clark was up to $1500 cheaper for same system quote by 2 other suppliers from solarquotes. I also found Glen Clark to be not pushy whereas one of the suppliers was too pushy and called far too many times to follow up.
Some of the sales people put me off, I didn't trust them at all

Glen offered very good alternatives to systems available. He was a bit slow with the initial inquiry but afterwards was very quick to prompt with his replies. Would definitely recommend him to anyone :)

At all times, Glen was courteous, helpful, informative and quick to respond to any query or request. He was the only guy willing to quote on the exact system I wanted - without trying to push me down a preferred path of a predetermined panel supplier or inverter supplier - I really appreciated that. His team were all friendly and worked efficiently throughout. We had a couple of teething problems - but one was very minor (and resolved immediately) and the other was a hardware issue that was not Glen's fault and which he had one of his guys devote 2 hours of time to resolve. I'm very glad to have found Glen (via Whirlpool and your website) - and enjoying my new solar system.

I found Glen Clark to be very informative. All my questions were addressed patiently and answered to my satisfaction. The installation was extremely well organised and went smoothly. Paul and Tristan were great. I would highly recommend Glen Clark Solar.

Glen Clark is organised and efficient; he understood what I wanted and didn't try to oversell. The installation team did a great job too. Very pleased.Essential Solar were a complete waste of time - didn't read what was asked for, didn't follow through with proposals, but simply delayed the whole process by a fortnight.Didn't hear from EnviroGroup.So I didn't really get the chance to compare quotes, but nevertheless am happy with the outcome.

After meeting with 2 of 3 of the recommended installers by Solar Quotes, I decided not go with them. One of them priced their systems with a significant premium and the other did not have a system that I was after.Read some other reviews about Glen Clark and decided to get in touch.Initial response was a little slow, but after the onsite visit by Glen himself, things start moving quickly.Installation took place within in a week of accepting the quote.Despite weather challenges, his team did a fantastic job with the installation and were consistently friendly and helpful.Top notch service and competitive pricing!

Glen and I discussed my list of requirements and installed exactly the system I was looking for. 5.61Kw is the result. His electrician background meant he was very knowledgable regarding the electrical connection and requirements. His team of installers left the install clean and tidy with no exposed wiring/conduits. Very happy.
As a buyer one needs to put a lot of work into the decision process, and its difficult to cover all bases the first time round. Actually installed a 5.7 kW system.
Had an issue with the placement of the panels but that was fixed, other than that everything was great.

Glen didn't BS me or try to up sell on anything, and he provided me with honest and forthright advice. The quality of work his team did was clean, neat and professional. The panels on the roof look fantastic too. Glen got absolutely everything spot on, first time. I'm extremely pleased with the focus Glen gave to my requests and the outcomes we achieved. Thanks.
I love the service from Glen Clark & Co. It was amazing what they did and quote. I will go back as a customer again. The company is highly recommended.

Glen responded within 24 hours to Solar Quotes' request to supply a quote to extend our exist ting solar electricity system.He asked one question then generated a quote according to my parameters within 48 hours.He made an appointment for an on-site inspection and arrived on time and properly briefed.We discussed use patterns, installation costs, my current energy purchase tariffs and 2017+ feed-in tariffs.Glen recommended no extension to our existing system on cost recovery grounds.He would have liked my money.I would rather spend it on a flight to Hamburg or Paris or ...

Glen visited and discussed options (last year). Then this when I revisited the idea of getting solar panels he was happy to revise his quote and discuss other options I put forward after further research. He also gets very good feedback on the Whirlpool Forums (which is where I first came across his name). Our system utilises LG 315 w mono panels and Enphase M250 microinverters.We chose this system because we have some shading (and don't wish to remove the tree cover due to the advantages of micro-climate control) and also with the cloudy Melbourne weather the new LG mono (neon) panels plus the micro inverter system should give use a better outcome.

I wanted a SolarEdge system but most installers did not sell it or charged exorbitant prices. Glen installed whatever equipment I asked for at a fair price and answered all my questions, as well as provide a variety of quotes for different brands and configurations. Only problem was the system did not work after the installed! Took over a week to fix the problem but it did get fixed eventually.
Great service from the beginning of obtaining a quote, to the installation and follow up paper work.

The two companies that you referred - Just Energy and the Mark Group were a total waste of my time. These are sales focussed organisations and did not pay much attention to what I wanted or needed.I did get independant quotes from Solargain and Glen Clark, both of which I would recommend to others looking for solar in Melbourne.

I had no problems at all.All installers providing quotes were VERY professional and seemed to be totally on top of their field.I installed a 3.5 with LG panels and Enphase micro-inverters and am looking forward to the near future when Enphase will bring out modular battery storage that will allow me to draw shoulder /evening energy from generated power also.
We found Glen Clark the only one who kept us informed at every step.Other installers promised something but did not follow through.

Glen was able to provide us with a detailed quote via email within a couple of days. His quote had attached an aerial view with proposed pv panel locations and expected power production figures etc.We had Glen come out for a site visit to discuss variations to the original proposal and he was prompt and gave us a couple of alternative optionsWe found Glen to be professional in his approach and kept us informed throughout the whole process and would not hesitate in recommending him

Glen provided a fantastic assessment of the output of our system.  He redesigned to suit our need for high afternoon use (the after school stuff).  He was able to provide a detailed quote without a site visit, and then came out to us to talk us through the quote, just the approach we wanted.We only ended out getting one quote through your service - Environ Melbourne.  Enviroshop made a phone appointment time but didn't call - called much later in the day to reschedule but when I couldn't give them a suitable time off-the-cuff (it was mad kiddie hour!) they didn't follow up further.  Mark Group did not give us a quote - they wanted an energy efficiency advisor to do a site visit first, whereas we simply wanted a solar quote.

Glen and his team did a very good job with our installation. The units have been operating for nearly 2 months now and have performed very well, exceeding my expectations for the power generated. Glen's team were good to work with and I thought that they were genuine and really took pride in their work. I am very happy to recommend them to others as great installers.
Performance of the system is exactly as described in the quote.
Glen did a great install, very professional.  I cannot say enough about the quality of his work.Anyone in Melbourne looking for an installer I would highly recommend him.

Glen Clark was the only installer who is an actual electrician and not some sales person. Customer service good, excellent LG panels and Power-one aurora micro inverters.Sorry to say Mark Group did not bother to e-mail a quote and did not bother to reply to my e-mails. They just disappeared - very poor customer service.Shine On let me down also.

Brad Townsend from SolarMyHome came promptly and was informative and gave a good priced configuration. But we weren't happy with likely shading issues for where he wanted to put the panels.Madison seemed to want to do everything online and not visit. Plus the information on their web site was inconsistent and confusing. Then you'd call and get different details.The Mark Group rep couldn't compete on price and recommended I look at another provider as he thought they were heaps cheaper. But when you got the details from this competitor, they actually were about the same as the prices we'd been given.We decided to go ahead with a system from Glen Clarke & Co for $12,500. It is a 7 kW setup using an Aurora PVI6000-OUTD-AU inverter located in the garage, with 28 ET Solar M660250 250W mono panels setup on reverse tilt angle frames on the south side of the roof. This solution resolved all of the shading issues, plus uses the capabilities of the inverter to the max.

The installer we chose, Glen Clark & Co. came via a recommendation from the whirlpool forums, he understood very quickly that I was after the best value system, so the best mix of quality and price.He went through the quality products and discussed the pros and cons of each, at the end we decided on an Aurora Inverter with 20 x 250 ET Panels, for a cost of $10,400.Glen has taken care of everything that is in his power to manage and the entire experience has been painless.

Was quite a pleasant experience, Glen Clark was professional in his design and quoting and responded to any questions promptly. I liked that he was an experienced electrical contractor who both did the site visit and the installation.
A bit slow due to inverter supply issues but I would not compromise.

Glen was always helpful and took time to explain everything. The installation was done when he said it would be and the inspector was here the next day, so no delay in getting the system working. We changed twice from our original idea and he was happy to adjust the quote and advise us of any necessary alterations to the system. Everything was done by email which was very convenient.
Glen Clark was very knowledgeable and thorough, providing multiple installation options as there was some shading on our roof. He completed the installation quickly and without any hassles.

It is definitely a good idea for consumers to do a lot of research about the installer.  This is almost more important than the products you choose because there are so many standards for the products to comply with (all good stuff thanks to the Clean Energy Council).  Consumers must remember that any industry with considerable govt rebates that are available for limited time will have a lot of people who are not in the industry for the long haul (think the insulation scheme!).  So do your research and choose carefully.

Glen gave us the best price with quality components.  There were some small communication issues with keeping us informed of an install date, which had to be delayed due to a large amount of wet weather.  I had to call Glen twice to ask about the date, and we were given very short notice of our install date.  Install itself was professional and system is running well.  Glen will also provide us with after sales service should it be required.

Excellent experience with Glen Clarke. Glen is very responsive and offered the best value for money out of 4 quotes. He did what he promised to do on the agreed dates and provided a very professional service. His predicted performance of the system was accurate and a small problem with condensation in the electrical breakers was fixed immediately by replacing them at his cost to a better type and brand. The documentation provided with the system was complete and professionally organised and presented. The solar panels are not top brands, however I am satisfied with the quality, certificates and warranties provided (something has to justify the lower price). The inverter is of good quality. I am very satisfied with the supply and performance of Glen and with the system he installed. I highly recommend Glen Clark.
It was a 1.8 kW system, with an inverter and wiring to enable me to double its size just by adding more panels.
I've marked down the Quality of system solely because I have not had it installed long enough to make an accurate assessment.  Generally the system seems fine.
Glen Clark is an excellent person to work with on Solar installation.  He is very professional, very well organised and the products he installs are first class. I would use him again.
